description: "Liber Amoris, Or, The New Pygmalion" by William Hazlitt is a romantic narrative, likely written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The work explores themes of unrequited love and the emotional turmoil that accompanies deep attachments, centering around the complex relationship between the main character and a woman referred to as Sarah.

authorInfo.bio: William Hazlitt (1778–1830) wrote Liber Amoris, Or, The New Pygmalion. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
